requirements.title: Implement a versioned provider-adapter SDK, lifecycle, capability-level model, support-matrix schema, event contract, removal contract, and conformance harness.

Implement immutable-digest artifact discovery, verification, download, promotion, retention, and provenance links for OCI Distribution, GitHub Container Registry, Azure Container Registry, JFrog Artifactory, and Sonatype Nexus.
Define and enforce the single-use `CapabilityGrant` contract for every authority-bearing action.

Implement a Backstage reference catalog adapter linking services, owners, repositories, pipelines, artifacts, environments, telemetry, incidents, and releases; retain Port, Cortex, and Compass as conformance-gated extensions.
Load and validate versioned configuration without silently broadening authority.
Implement inspect, correlate, dispatch, rerun, cancel, approve, log, and artifact behavior for GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, GitLab CI, and Jenkins as separate read and execute capabilities.
Make SQLite the sole authority for sessions, tasks, checkpoints, grants, and receipts.

Implement a provider-neutral delivery graph linking services, work, source, reviews, builds, artifacts, provenance, deployments, environments, telemetry, incidents, findings, releases, and rollback with immutable source identities and freshness.
Implement plan, diff, promote, health, drift, synchronize, and rollback support for Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, and Flux with immutable artifacts and environment-specific deployment grants.

Produce a redacted local doctor response inside native Visual Studio Code Chat for model/runtime identity, offline state, platform boundary, workspace grant, capability versions, repository-map health, encrypted storage, and session recovery without exposing secrets; retain a non-user-facing diagnostic harness for automated testing.
Publish startup, limitation, privacy, recovery, and offline-verification instructions.
Require a receipt for every tool action and a resolvable citation for every file-grounded claim.
Label material claims as Observed, Derived, Inferred, or Unknown/Blocked and bind citations to source hashes and ranges so changed evidence becomes visibly stale.

Define v1.0 GA as the first supported public release, freeze its Fedora, Ubuntu, and Windows 11 x64 platform matrix, retain Apple Silicon macOS as post-GA work, and publish exact promoted and unsupported capabilities.

Produce the v1.0 GA release decision from current Fedora, Ubuntu, Windows, strict-local, connected, provider-conformance, support-matrix, supply-chain, recovery, accessibility, and independent-review evidence.

Support GitHub.com and user-approved GitHub Enterprise Server repositories, commits, issues, pull requests, reviews, checks, workflows, releases, local signed commits, approval-gated pushes, and hosted mutations within a published matrix.
Implement read-only Git status, diff, log, branch, and object inspection.
Render a local, reviewable Codex handoff packet without invoking Codex, controlling its tab, writing the clipboard, or transmitting content.
Implement inspect, plan, policy-check, apply, reconcile, and recover support for Terraform and OpenTofu while keeping destructive and production actions separately approved.

Bind every connected credential and operation to exact provider, host, tenant, account, project, environment, capability class, purpose, scope, expiry, and secret-store reference without exposing secret values.

Implement incident correlation, evidence, draft communication, bounded issue creation, escalation, rollback recommendation, and notification adapters with PagerDuty and compatible incident systems as independently gated capabilities.

Treat repository instructions and all workspace text as untrusted content; allow only cited or explicitly trust-gated behavioral guidance that cannot change policy, grants, roots, tools, or user intent.
Implement the interface-independent kernel boundary and typed task, tool, result, and receipt contracts.

Verify the same manifest-pinned Gemma 4 E4B profile through native `llama.cpp` on macOS, Fedora, and Ubuntu, and through the separately gated Docker Model Runner compatibility adapter on Linux; require contract and evaluation parity before enabling either Linux adapter.
Use deterministic operations first and explicit user model selection; record benchmark data without automatic routing.

Implement the separate approved-model installer/importer with hardware-fit checks, license and lineage display, resumable staging, hash verification, quarantine, atomic activation, self-test, unload, and cleanup.
Author, preserve, review, and render inline and display LaTeX-style mathematics in Markdown through a pinned offline safe subset with round-trip and accessibility support.
Enforce offline operation and restrict the selected local inference runtime to the guarded inference path.

Use OpenTelemetry as the provider-neutral correlation foundation and implement reference adapters for Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, Elastic, Splunk, and Sentry without converting correlation into unsupported causation.
Implement and package the platform-adapter boundary for Apple Silicon macOS, Fedora, and Ubuntu, with MacBook Pro M5 as the primary launch reference.
Classify data before persistence and enforce encryption, minimization, retention, and operating-system key storage.
Enforce canonical workspace-relative capability paths through the platform path adapter while generating absolute paths only for display links.
Implement semantic-version, changelog, release-manifest, promotion, progressive-delivery, feature-flag, database-migration, health, rollback, and compensating-action contracts.

Build a deterministic, Git-aware, policy-aware repository map with pinned Tree-sitter parsers, supported-language symbols, reliable definitions/imports/relationships, bounded cache, coverage report, and exact source citations.
Implement the shared threat model and documented macOS and Linux process topologies.
Run every file and Git tool inside the restricted platform tool worker.
Normalize CodeQL, Semgrep, SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, and SARIF findings without erasing provider provenance, conflicting severity, suppression, reachability, or source identity.
Persist and resume one active local session without duplicating completed actions.
Implement conformance-gated source adapters for Azure Repos and GitLab, while keeping Bitbucket and Gerrit as disabled extension candidates until promoted.
Normalize and verify SPDX, CycloneDX, SARIF, Sigstore/Cosign signatures, SLSA provenance, vulnerability results, and policy decisions against exact source, build, and artifact identities.
Implement bounded list, read, search, metadata, and hash tools.
Run the complete platform, path, sandbox, instruction-injection, network, privacy, handoff, and crash security suite.
Run the repository-map, evidence-state, model lifecycle, diagnostics, quality, latency, memory, context, and model capability suite against fixed fixtures.
Register AgentMage as a Visual Studio Code language-model chat provider and expose Gemma 4 E4B in the native model picker.
Stream local responses, evidence states, citations, progress, cancellation, diagnostics, and failures in native Visual Studio Code Chat.

Implement and package the complete Windows 11 x64 platform boundary, including signed per-user installation, authenticated IPC, restricted workers, NTFS path safety, DPAPI key protection, native model inference, connected workers, accessibility, recovery, and removal.

Implement conformance-gated work-management adapters for GitHub Issues, Jira Cloud, Jira Data Center, and Azure Boards with stable identity, links, drafts, bounded writes, and complete audit receipts.

Run cross-provider, cross-platform, adversarial, mutation, fuzz, replay, confusion, partition, rate-limit, version-skew, crash, partial-effect, rollback, resource, removal, and end-to-end delivery tests with no hidden blocking result.
Run the adapter lifecycle and capability-level suite against fake, fault, reference, future-version, and malicious providers.
Static and runtime dependency checks across kernel, Core Read-Only pack, and Visual Studio Code shell.
Discover, verify, download, compare, promote, retain, and remove artifacts across OCI, GitHub Container Registry, Azure Container Registry, Artifactory, and Nexus fixtures.
Grant mutation, replay, expiry, nonce reuse, preimage change, task change, target change, uncertain-result retry, and child-scope tests.
Build Backstage service-catalog relationships and run extension-contract fixtures for Port, Cortex, and Compass.
Invalid, unknown, and permission-broadening configuration mutations.
Inspect and execute GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, GitLab CI, and Jenkins fixtures across refs, inputs, environments, permissions, logs, artifacts, cancellation, rerun, and uncertain results.
Forced termination during model, file, Git, receipt, and checkpoint phases.
Transaction and migration invariants with crashes injected at every durable-write boundary.
Build and mutate delivery graphs spanning work item, source, review, CI, artifact, provenance, deployment, telemetry, incident, release, and rollback fixtures.
Plan, preview, promote, health-check, detect drift, synchronize, fail, cancel, and roll back Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, and Flux fixtures.

Redacted local doctor results rendered inside native Visual Studio Code Chat across model, runtime, offline, sandbox/helper, workspace, capability, repository-map, encrypted-store, receipt, and recovery states.
Three clean installations, one each on MacBook Pro M5, Fedora, and Ubuntu, by a reader using only published instructions.
Tool-action receipt coverage.
File-grounded claim and citation scoring against a labeled corpus.
Evidence-state, deterministic-derivation, citation-hash, source-range, conflict, and stale-citation scoring against a labeled corpus.
Rebuild all requirements and run the exact v1.0 GA platform, strict-local, connected, delivery, support-matrix, supply-chain, recovery, accessibility, documentation, and independent-review gates.

Exercise the complete published GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Server matrix across version, permission, object, branch, issue, pull request, review, workflow, release, local commit, signed push, and failure fixtures.
Read-only Git operations across clean, dirty, detached, untracked, and malformed fixture repositories.
Local Codex-handoff generation plus direct-request, prompt-injection, tool-call, Visual Studio Code command, clipboard, and network-delivery attempts.
Inspect, plan, policy-check, apply, crash, reconcile, and recover Terraform and OpenTofu fixtures including destructive, stale-state, lock, provider, and secret cases.
Cross product provider, host, tenant, account, project, environment, credential, redirect, proxy, callback, and operation fixtures.
Detect, correlate, draft, notify, create bounded work, recommend rollback, recover, and close incident fixtures across duplicate, delayed, partial, conflicting, and injected data.
Prompt-injection and malicious-content suite.

Repository-instruction trust and precedence suite covering nested instructions, conflicts, generated text, comments, policy-change requests, hidden-tool requests, broader-root requests, external transfer, and false-completion instructions.

Admission record, license, publisher/control, lineage, artifact, tokenizer, native GGUF hash, immutable OCI digest where applicable, runtime, acceleration, and offline response verification for Gemma 4 E4B.
Installer/importer preflight, acquisition, cancellation, recovery, quarantine, atomic activation, self-test, load/unload, and cleanup across the supported platform matrix.

Round-trip and render Markdown containing inline/display mathematics, labels, references, escaping, code fences, malformed input, hostile commands, deep macros, accessibility labels, and cross-platform fixtures.

Packet, socket, process, container, namespace, and Domain Name System monitoring for a 60-minute offline end-to-end run after the separate model installer has exited on each supported platform and adapter.
Reachability probes from a local-area-network peer, unrelated same-user process, ordinary container where applicable, separate network namespace, tool worker, XPC helper, extension host, and kernel.
Correlate OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, Elastic, Splunk, and Sentry metrics, logs, traces, errors, monitors, releases, and time windows.
Absolute path, traversal, encoding, separator, symlink, alias, stale-bookmark, case-folding, Unicode-normalization, rename-race, mount, and file-replacement attacks.
Five warmups and 30 measured runs on the recorded MacBook Pro M5 and Fedora reference machines, with functional budget verification on clean Ubuntu.
Clean first-run packaging and platform-adapter verification on MacBook Pro M5, Fedora, and Ubuntu.
Secret canaries in prompts, files, attachments, tool output, errors, and model responses.
Encryption, ephemeral fallback, expiry, export, and cryptographic-erasure tests.
Labeled read-only repository questions, extraction tasks, schema calls, malformed-tool recovery, and adversarial completion prompts.
Run version, changelog, manifest, promotion, flag, progressive-delivery, migration, health, rollback, and compensation fixtures.
Deterministic repository-map construction, invalidation, coverage, rendering, source resolution, and read-only invariants across supported and unsupported fixture repositories.
Resume after file, instruction, model-digest, permission, branch, repository-map, citation, and workspace changes.
Mixed deterministic and model-assisted task suite.
Per-platform sandbox escape suite covering filesystem, process, device, environment, namespace, XPC, bookmark, and entitlement attacks.
Process, socket, file-permission, entitlement, environment, identity, and privilege inspection on macOS, Fedora, and Ubuntu.
Ingest and reconcile CodeQL, Semgrep, SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, and SARIF findings with conflicting severity, locations, suppressions, reachability, and tool versions.

Static cross-document validation of v0.1 scope, backlog, dependency, acceptance-test, release, platform, model, runtime, repository-map, evidence-state, diagnostics, policy, license, and data-authority statements.
Exercise Azure Repos and GitLab repository, branch, commit, review, policy, local-worktree, signed-commit, and push fixtures.
Validate SPDX, CycloneDX, Sigstore/Cosign, SLSA, policy, vulnerability, source, build, and artifact fixture chains.
Golden list, read, search, metadata, and hash fixtures with size and result limits.
Clean extension and kernel-host installation plus model discovery on MacBook Pro M5, Fedora, and Ubuntu.
Native Chat streaming, evidence-state, citation, diagnostics, progress, cancellation, unavailable-model, and malformed-response tests.

Run clean install, package identity, IPC, AppContainer, NTFS path/race, DPAPI, native model, strict-local network, delivery adapter, accessibility, update, rollback, uninstall, and residue suites on Windows 11 x64.
Exercise GitHub Issues, Jira Cloud, Jira Data Center, and Azure Boards reads, links, drafts, field updates, comments, transitions, attachments, permissions, pagination, and recovery.

Run cross-provider and cross-platform contract mutation, fuzzing, hostile content, credential confusion, event replay, version skew, rate limit, partition, crash, cancellation, partial effect, rollback, resource, removal, and end-to-end lifecycle campaigns.
Redacted runtime and capability diagnostics
Gemma 4 quality, tool-recovery, context, latency, citation, and injection evaluation on reference hardware
Observed, Derived, Inferred, and Unknown/Blocked answer states with resolvable and stale-aware citations
Complete approved local-model acquisition, verification, fit, lifecycle, diagnostics, cancellation, and offline proof
Deterministic, policy-aware, citation-preserving read-only repository map without required embeddings
Repository, notes, issues, tool output, and imported instructions remain untrusted data unless explicitly trust-gated as non-authority guidance
Optional approved local hybrid structural, lexical, embedding, and reranking retrieval with deletion and deterministic fallback
Provider-independent allowlisted internal roles for dialogue, tools, summaries, repository maps, embeddings, reranking, patches, and claim verification
Session fork, citation-preserving compaction, encrypted archive, controlled deletion, and redacted evidence bundle
Declarative, provenance-recorded, trust-gated skills before executable plugins
Separately approved trusted test, lint, formatter, build, and scan templates with evidence-based receipts
Git worktree isolation that supplements, but is never described as, the security sandbox
Exact-preimage controlled-write transaction with shadow changes, one-use grant, atomic application, receipts, verification, and rollback
CLI, JSON, software development kit, and Agent Client Protocol only after stable VS Code, with predeclared grants and fail-closed headless behavior
User-initiated read-only GitHub and connector synchronization into a sensitivity-labeled local cache
Leased, idempotent, budgeted, cancellable, expiring scheduled work with read-only first release and post-run receipts
Child grants, separate writable worktrees, ownership, conflicts, budgets, cancellation propagation, and attributable receipts
Manifested MCP and plugins fully mediated by the kernel, with identity, scopes, limits, cancellation, receipts, and a read-only first phase
